prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one static Hearts of Iron IV stockpile-cost texticon, exact final canvas 30x12 pixels.
Primary request: Create an original, nontechnical inventory glyph consisting only of the standard public biological-hazard pictogram: its familiar three-lobed trefoil and central node, with no enclosing sign or additional imagery.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent canvas. The symbol floats alone with no surface or setting.
Subject: One centered biological-hazard pictogram sized to a compact 12x12 footprint on the 30x12 canvas, leaving clear transparent space on the left and right.
Style/medium: Flat 2D game-interface glyph with subtle painted UI shading, pale desaturated sage-green and ivory fills, restrained dark olive edge contrast, clean symmetrical lobes, and crisp simple shapes that remain legible at 12x12.
Composition/framing: Use the exact 30x12 inline texticon canvas. Keep the entire pictogram centered, self-contained, and within a 12x12 area. Preserve transparent left and right margins.
Lighting/mood: Minimal soft shading only, no scene lighting.
Constraints: Genuine transparent unused pixels; depict only the standard public biological-hazard pictogram. No enclosing triangle, ring, badge, border, frame, tile, plaque, shield, sticker, medallion, or background. No container, weapon, device, mechanism, organism, microbe, person, text, letters, numbers, watermark, or extra symbol. Keep the mark simple, smooth, and clearly recognizable after downsampling to 12x12.
Avoid: Any functional object or process depiction, any additional iconography, fake checkerboard, opaque matte, colored halo, clipped edges, or unintended transparent holes.
